invariants.rationale: The children collection is dereferenced and used throughout the method, so it must be non-null prior to method return.
Array sizes in Java are always non-negative; children.size is accessed and looped on.
If wrap were true, the method would return early via the layoutWrapped() and return statement.

invariants.expression: i == n || i == n + incr || i == n - incr
invariants.rationale: After the for-loop, i has passed n by incr, which is a classic off-by-one termination property.
n is set to children.size for forward iteration, -1 for reverse.
